title: Ingest
description: Output of `rulekit ingest` — a stored rule's condition read back. `converted` true = rulekit fully modeled every construct (an ordinary AST, ready for explain/diff); false = a tolerant Opaque passthrough preserving the kernel's text verbatim for constructs not yet modeled.

converted.description: true = Converted (full rulekit AST); false = Opaque (verbatim passthrough)

condition.description: the rendered DSL (Converted) or the raw kernel condition text (Opaque)
